title: HOW ROCKETS ARE MADE (Rocket Factory Tour - United Launch Alliance) - Smarter Every Day 231
summary: Destin Sandlin tours United Launch Alliance's rocket factory with CEO Tory Bruno, showing friction stir welding, structural rocket skins and large milled parts.
why: HN recommends it as a rare look inside a rocket factory and cites it for manufacturing details like welding methods.

quote.text: If you haven't watched Smarter Every Day's ULA factory tour I highly recommend it.
